WITH group_stats AS (
  SELECT
    o.timespan,
    AVG(f.rebrate / NULLIF(f.feerate, 0)) AS avg_ratio,
    COUNT(*) AS fee_record_count
  FROM fees AS f
  JOIN orders AS o
    ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault
  GROUP BY o.timespan
),
with_average AS (
  SELECT
    avg_ratio,
    fee_record_count,
    AVG(fee_record_count) OVER () AS cross_group_avg_count
  FROM group_stats
),
kept_groups AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM with_average
  WHERE fee_record_count > cross_group_avg_count
)
SELECT
  AVG(avg_ratio) AS average_of_average_ratios,
  SUM(fee_record_count) AS total_fee_record_count,
  AVG(fee_record_count - cross_group_avg_count) AS average_excess_count
FROM kept_groups;
